facts.text: SQL Server compatibility level on the on-premises database must be 130 or higher
Change tracking must be enabled on the on-premises database, or migration will fail
Users managing cloud migration require a Business Central license and the SUPER permission set
On-premises deployment must run Business Central version 25.0 or later; version 24 or earlier cannot migrate directly
Simply uninstalling cloud migration apps does not properly disable migration and can cause permission errors
Records in Tenant Media table cannot be migrated if their size exceeds the maximum size in data handling limits
If table extension records are missing after successful migration, run the Repair Companion Table Records action
